reproduction.rationale: One Bugeon task retains both first-class outcomes and two matched information conditions. Original nine-panel source identities, authentic calcium/metadata manifests, submitted-analysis execution and independent granular-output verification, common evaluator/exposure policy and cumulative budgets are unresolved. Reproduction cannot shrink to the eight current structurally compatible panels; the original comparator/ablation set and statistical equivalence rules must first be recovered. The same original scientific identity must be bound across outcomes and code must be the only within-pair information addition; no protocol or identity hash is invented.

improvement.rationale: One Bugeon task retains both first-class outcomes and two matched information conditions. Original nine-panel source identities, authentic calcium/metadata manifests, submitted-analysis execution and independent granular-output verification, common evaluator/exposure policy and cumulative budgets are unresolved. Improvement retains its unchanged predeclared original-panel and stronger-of-published-and-calibrated comparator rules, including LOLCAT for E/I inductive; it cannot inherit a reproduction result or substitute a favorable current-source panel. The same original scientific identity must be bound across outcomes and code must be the only within-pair information addition; no protocol or identity hash is invented.
